Quota comes only from data already on this computer and from what the official CLI fetches itself when you click Refresh; the login method is read only from the official login status.
隐私：Nomi 不读取、不保存、不上传任何登录凭据（不打开 auth.json、: Privacy: Nomi never reads, stores or uploads any login credentials (it does not open auth.json, .credentials.json or the system keychain). When you click Refresh and the snapshot is out of date, the official CLI (claude -p /usage, codex app-server, Grok ACP billing) is started briefly and fetches the quota with its own login; Nomi keeps only the percentage, window, reset time and plan. There is no automatic polling, and each tool is refreshed at most once per 60 seconds; you can turn off "Active quota refresh" under "Privacy & data".
